the sign flip at p>64 makes cosine match cos(2*pi*p/256) for all p in [0,128]; sine = table[|64-p|] = cos((|64-p|)*2*pi/256) = |sin(2*pi*p/256)|, but the function returns -sine, i.e. wi = -|sin(theta)| for p in [0,128]; this is a consistent forward-FFT (negative-exponent) convention W = cos - i*sin only if the caller's phase ordering matches — the sign correctness is ultimately an empirical question tied to claim c1.", "Phase ranges are in-bounds for all widths: stage phases max out at (half-1)*(256/width) < 128 (e.g. N=256 first stage: 63*2=126) and reconstruction phases max at (M-1)*(256/N) <= 127 for N=256 (k up to 127, factor 1) — so folded/abs indices never exceed the 65-entry table; no out-of-bounds table load is expected at any legal width.", "Nyquist identity check (supports c2 design): with Z = FFT_M(z), z[j] = x[2j] + i*x[2j+1], one has Re(Z[0]) = sum x[even], Im(Z[0]) = sum x[odd], and X[N/2] = sum (-1)^j x[j] = sum x[even] - sum x[odd] = Re(Z[0]) - Im(Z[0]); so line 83's (ar - ai) at lane k==0 (address=Z[0] since bit-reversal of 0 is 0) is mathematically correct, and the imag part 0.0 store is exact; remaining risk is purely whether the gathered Z[0] lane is correct (bit-reversal/gather) — a probe comparing only bins k=0 and k=N/2 against rfft isolates it.", "Masked Nyquist stores at lines 83-84 write to distinct addresses (row*(M+1)+M)*2 from lane k==0 only; the unmasked stores at lines 81-82 only cover k=0..M-1, so no address collision exists by construction — the c2 'store clobbering' sub-risk reduces to gather/bit-reversal correctness.", "Numeric-scale note for c3: FP64 radix-2 FFT relative error grows ~O(log M)*eps (~1e-15 scale), so for max-magnitude rows (|X| up to ~1.68e7) absolute intermediate error is ~1e-8..1e-9 before cancellation — the earlier ~1e-3 estimate was pessimistic; the binding risk for c3 is the final FP32 cast ulp (~6e-7 relative, fine under the 1e-6 relative term) plus genuine cancellation bins where the 1e-4 absolute term should still dominate FP64-level error; adversarial probes should target coherent inputs with exact X[k] near zero and confirm the FP32 cast, not the FP64 pipeline, is the limiting factor."], "open_questions": ["Is the wi = -|sin| convention in _twiddle combined with the DIF butterfly/reconstruction index ordering equivalent to exp(-i*theta) twiddles for all three widths — this is exactly what claim c1 probes empirically;
